name: WeChat Social Assistant
description: OpenClaw native bridge to the local-first WeChat Social Assistant MCP server.

projectRoot.description: Optional trusted checkout containing the wsa Python package.

dbPath.description: Optional path to the local social.db.

allowedRoot.description: Trusted root for MCP database, screenshots, and log paths; defaults to the database directory.

pythonPath.description: Python executable that can import wsa. Defaults to python3.

trustedWrites.description: Expose write tools. Each write still requires the MCP confirmation fields.
